id: \bYou look like you may need this.
en: \bYou look like you may need this.
it: \bSembra che questo potrebbe servirti.

id: \bThat's an Experience Share. It gives experience to a Pokémon even if it didn't battle.
en: \bThat's an Experience Share. It gives experience to a Pokémon even if it didn't battle.
it: \bÈ un Condividi Esp. Dà esperienza a un Pokémon anche se non ha lottato.

id: \bGood to see you again. Let's see if I can beat you again.
en: \bGood to see you again. Let's see if I can beat you again.
it: \bChe bello rivederti. Vediamo se riesco a batterti di nuovo.

id: \bLooking forward to our next match.
en: \bLooking forward to our next match.
it: \bNon vedo l'ora del nostro prossimo incontro.

id: \bMachop!!
en: \bMachop!!
it: \bMachop!!

id: \bYou have a Pokédex. Do you know I made the entries for it?
en: \bYou have a Pokédex. Do you know I made the entries for it?
it: \bHai un Pokédex. Lo sai che le voci le ho scritte io?

id: \bI actually made a lot of them up. It's hard making Pokédex entries.
en: \bI actually made a lot of them up. It's hard making Pokédex entries.
it: \bIn realtà molte me le sono inventate. È difficile scrivere le voci del Pokédex.

id: \bI'm so nervous. What should I use?
en: \bI'm so nervous. What should I use?
it: \bSono nervosissimo. Cosa dovrei usare?

id: \rThe Indigo League is done. Come back next year.
en: \rThe Indigo League is done. Come back next year.
it: \rLa Lega Indaco è finita. Torna l'anno prossimo.

id: \bGood luck. You'll need it.
en: \bGood luck. You'll need it.
it: \bBuona fortuna. Ti servirà.

id: \bMy Sudowoodo needs help against water.
en: \bMy Sudowoodo needs help against water.
it: \bIl mio Sudowoodo ha bisogno di aiuto contro l'acqua.

id: \bI'm sure there's a way to do it.
en: \bI'm sure there's a way to do it.
it: \bSono sicuro che c'è un modo per farcela.

id: \rThis is the path to the Johto region. It is a dangerous path, so we advise people to stay away during the League.
en: \rThis is the path to the Johto region. It is a dangerous path, so we advise people to stay away during the League.
it: \rQuesta è la strada per la regione di Johto. È un percorso pericoloso, quindi durante la Lega consigliamo a tutti di starne lontani.

id: \rThis is the border between Kanto and Johto.
en: \rThis is the border between Kanto and Johto.
it: \rQuesto è il confine tra Kanto e Johto.

id: \bThe rules here used to be really complex. Due to too many complaints they were changed.
en: \bThe rules here used to be really complex. Due to too many complaints they were changed.
it: \bUna volta le regole qui erano complicatissime. Le hanno cambiate perché c'erano troppe lamentele.

id: \bI love being random!
en: \bI love being random!
it: \bAdoro essere imprevedibile!

id: \bI can teach your Pokémon a very random move, Metronome!
en: \bI can teach your Pokémon a very random move, Metronome!
it: \bPosso insegnare ai tuoi Pokémon una mossa davvero imprevedibile: Metronomo!

id: \bWhich Pokémon would you like me to teach?
en: \bWhich Pokémon would you like me to teach?
it: \bA quale Pokémon vuoi che la insegni?

id: \bCome back anytime!
en: \bCome back anytime!
it: \bTorna quando vuoi!

id: \rWe look forward to seeing you rematch the Indigo League, Monarch \PN.
en: \rWe look forward to seeing you rematch the Indigo League, Monarch \PN.
it: \rNon vediamo l'ora di vederti sfidare di nuovo la Lega Indaco, Monarca \PN.

id: You got your Frontier Pass back!
en: You got your Frontier Pass back!
it: Hai riavuto il tuo Pass Lotta!

id: Would you like to take Aipom with you?
en: Would you like to take Aipom with you?
it: Vuoi portare Aipom con te?

id: \bReady Machop!?
en: \bReady Machop!?
it: \bPronto, Machop!?

en: Yes
